player_prompt.intro:
Jichha {player_id} khitin Ch'iqusqan. Jichha p'iqix, janiw utjirakiw:
  + Q'awi:  '[attack M O]'  Jichha M=jichha wakichi (0 utji 1), O=jichha q'awirin wakichi (0 utji 1).
    - Q'awirin wakichin juk'ampis janiw jichha wakichin; juk'ampis 5 utjin, 0 manq'asax.
  + Manq'asi:   '[split L R]'  jichha wakichin juk'ampis janiw L utji R (L+R = jichha juk'ampi).
Janiw utjirakiw juk'ampis utji.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split ukax amparamamp maysar jaljtayir mayjt'ayaniwa.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Invalid move. Use “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} janiw q'awirin P{opp_id} wakichin {opp_idx}: kunan q'awirin {opp_val} manq'asax {new_val}.

outcome.draw: The turn limit has been reached.
